evidence.title: Fluid Orb — Animated React Component | Rare UI

name: Rare UI Components
summary: Index of 24 animated React components built with Tailwind and Motion, previewed on hover and installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: Browses every Rare UI component in one page — sidebars, OTP input, FAQ, gooey nav, animated orbs and other frosted-glass pieces — grouped as New releases, Display, AI kit, Navigation, Inputs and Feedback. Each component is a single file you own, added with the shadcn CLI or through MCP; free to use with an attribution link (MIT with Commons Clause).
contains: 24 components in six groups: New releases, Display, AI kit, Navigation, Inputs, Feedback
hover-to-play clip and live demo per component
single-file source you own; install with the shadcn CLI (npx shadcn add swamimalode07/rare-ui/<name>) or MCP
license: MIT with the Commons Clause; a visible credit link is required
